full_prompt_en: A square folk-surreal illustration shows a white-bearded man and a red-haired woman seated in profile beneath a round golden moon, surrounded by dense curling ornament. The background is dark blue-black but almost entirely filled with ochre and gold swirls, small faces, tree-like dark branches, and tiny symbolic forms. Near the upper center, the flat gold moon sits above the paired heads, giving the crowd of patterns a simple circular anchor. At center-left, the man faces left. He has short dark hair, dark glasses, a long white beard rendered in many small curls, and a solemn expression. His dark teal coat is filled with tiny stippled and floral-like marks over an ochre collar. Hands are clasped low in front of him. Immediately behind and to the right, the woman also faces left, her pale profile sharply cut against the patterned ground. Her hair is vivid copper red, gathered into a low knot, and a warm ochre garment covers her torso. Her hands meet low at the edge of the coat, with a broad red skirt or lower field occupying the bottom right. At the far left and far right, small partial figures and stylized animal-like heads appear among winding black limbs, all treated as part of the same ornamental surface rather than distant space. The illustrated texture is fine and even: grain, stippling, short hatching, and tightly repeated curls fill nearly every color area. Light is stylized rather than naturalistic; the pale faces and beard are bright, the gold moon and ochre pattern glow, and dark navy outlines hold them apart. No legible text appears. The overall composition is compact and storylike, with a calm paired profile set inside a busy, rhythmic field of dark branches and warm golden motifs.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形民俗超现实插画描绘一位白须男子和一位红发女子坐成侧面，头顶是一轮圆金月，四周充满密集卷曲纹饰。背景为深蓝近黑色，却几乎被赭色与金色旋纹、小脸、树状深枝和细小象征形体填满。上方中央附近，平涂金月位于两颗头上方，为繁忙纹样提供简单圆形支点。中央偏左，男子面朝左。他有短深发、深色眼镜、由许多小卷线表现的长白胡须和庄重神情。深青绿外套在赭色领口外布满细点及花状痕。他的双手在前方低处相握。紧贴其后和右边，女子也面朝左，浅色侧脸从纹样底面前锋利切出。头发呈鲜铜红，在后方结成低髻，暖赭色衣服罩住躯干。她的双手在外套边缘低处靠拢，宽阔红裙或下方色域占据右下。最左和最右，小型局部人形及造型化动物状头从缠绕黑枝中出现，都被处理为同一装饰表面的一部分，而非远处空间。插画肌理纤细均匀：颗粒、点痕、短排线和紧密重复卷线填满几乎每片色域。光经过造型化处理，而非自然主义；浅色面庞与胡须明亮，金月和赭色纹样发光，深海蓝轮廓将其分开。没有可读文字。整体构图紧凑而有故事感，平静的双人侧脸置于深枝和暖金纹样组成的繁忙节奏场中。
style_prompt_en: This folk-surreal illustrative style fills shallow space with fine stippling, tight curls, short hatching, and winding dark lines. Ochre, antique gold, copper red, pale ivory, and deep navy form an earthy but high-contrast palette. A few clear pale silhouettes and one simple circular accent steady the intricate all-over ornament, while small motifs echo the larger curves. Forms are edged by confident dark contours and textured internally rather than modeled with smooth gradients. Light is symbolic and evenly distributed among pale and gold areas, with dark blue-black passages providing separation and depth. The composition is dense, intimate, and rhythmic, balancing calm central masses with lively peripheral detail.
style_prompt_zh: 这种民俗超现实插画风格以细点、紧密卷线、短排线和缠绕深线填满浅空间。赭色、古金、铜红、浅象牙及深海蓝形成土色却高反差的配色。少数清楚浅色剪影与一个简单圆形强调稳住繁复满幅纹饰，小纹样呼应较大曲线。形体由肯定的深色轮廓围住，内部以肌理填充，而非平滑渐层塑形。光具有象征性，在浅色和金色区域均匀分布，深蓝近黑区域提供分隔与纵深。构图密集、亲近而有节奏，以平静中央大块平衡活泼周边细节。
theme_en: A bearded man and red-haired woman beneath a patterned golden moon
theme_zh: 花纹金月下的白须男子与红发女子
name: Mark Briscoe
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
